newsitem.title: GERMANY: Croatia says mark Eurobond to have 7-year maturity.
newsitem.headline: Croatia says mark Eurobond to have 7-year maturity.

text.p: Croatia's first ever deutschemark Eurobond will have a seven year maturity and a volume of 300 to 400 million marks, Finance Minister Bozo Prka said on Wednesday.
Speaking at a presentation in Frankfurt, Prka said conditions for the bond would be set at the start of next week.
He gave no details of the projected coupon. Consortium sources were mooting 90 to 100 points over the corresponding German government bond.
Prka said the mark bond would be Croatia's last international issue this year.
Joint lead managers for the transaction are Credit Suisse First Boston and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Croatia made its debut on the Eurobond market in February with a $300 milion five-year bond with a seven-percent coupon, or 80 basis points more than U.S. Treasury notes.
The former Yugoslav republic's sovereign debt is rated BBB- by Standard & Poor's.
